name: Macrophobia
source:
In a world not unlike our own, giant anthros have popped up unexpectedly all over, with tragic consequences for many. You are just one hunter trying your best to defend against these macros, but can you steel yourself and do the right thing when it counts?

[From [url=https://gatrgroh.itch.io/macrophobia]Itch.io[/url]]
